source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-13 from the table's own CA(49;3,352,2) (Power CT over GF(11), row S7, file table/arrays/CA_49_3_352_2.txt). Its 49 rows fall into five blocks in which each column shows one of 11, 11, 11, 8 or 4 patterns, so a column is a word over alphabets of these sizes; in every block any three distinct patterns show all non-constant triples, so a set of words is a strength-3 covering array if and only if no word agrees coordinate by coordinate with one of two other words (programs/alg2.py checks this). New words (t, t+u, t+v, x, y) over Z11 with one point (u, v) in each slab (x, y) and three points in slab (0, 0), placed by one CaDiCaL 1.5.3 call through python-sat 1.9.dev22 on the line rules forced by the condition (programs/qmodel.py 3, deterministic), give 374 words. programs/recipe.sh runs it; a run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 3-sets
construction: Words over the five row blocks of the Power CT CA(49;3,352,2), redesigned as lines of Z11 x Z11 with three points in one slab, placed by exact SAT
notes: one row below the cited size 50 at k = 374; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
